function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a given command using the os.system() function specifically for Windows operating systems. For multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For complex tasks, create and run a .bat file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The Windows command line instruction(s) to be executed. Use '&&' between commands for multiple instructions. For complex sequences, encapsulate the logic within a .bat file and provide the execution command here.

message.reasoning:
The user says: "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. They likely want to run a command to start Docker service. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. On Windows, you can start Docker Desktop via the UI or via command line. There's also "docker start" to start a container. To start Docker service, you might use "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service -Name com.docker.service" in PowerShell. Or "sc start com.docker.service". Or "docker-machine start default" if using Docker Machine.

We can also mention that Docker Desktop must be installed. Then you can start it via "Start-Process 'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe'" or "docker-machine start default".
